author: GamingBolt
description:
We really enjoy diving into these Crimson Desert updates, partly because it's lovely to see such diligent evolution of an already solid title, but also because it’s quite fascinating to see a single-player game receive live-service treatment. 

The developer has shifted its focus to customising your houses after a couple of pet-focused updates in the past few weeks, and the results are quite intriguing. Join us as we take a look at what’s new, what’s changed, and what’s been fixed in the game this time around. It's a relatively long list, so settle in!
title: Crimson Desert Latest Update - 10 Biggest Changes And Improvements You Need To Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
Control Resonant might not seem like it has any connection to the inFAMOUS franchise if all you give it is a cursory glance. But look a little deeper and you’re going to see a bunch of similarities even as you see how Remedy has put its own spin on a superpowered fantasy set in a version of a modern city that you’re then let loose in. 

There are differences that stem from it, but both of them scratch a very specific itch, one that has been largely ignored despite the potential for some unmatched entertainment stemming from it. 

We’re here to lay it all out, as we explore how Resonant could be the perfect placebo for those among you who are hoping for a new title in Sucker Punch’s iconic franchise. Join us as we compare the two heavyweights, and see how they each manage to deliver a unique take on how an individual with powers can stand tall against a world gone horribly wrong.
title: Control Resonant Might Be The inFamous Style PS5 Game You Never Knew You Wanted

author: GamingBolt
description:
Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced is now closed enough for the long wait to feel tantalizing as it nears its end. There’s a lot to unpack thanks to it insightful additions and nifty tweaks that are aimed at making Edward an Assassin/pirate whom even the most fearsome of opponents would think twice about taking on. 

From new story missions to changes in how you move around and fight on the land and seas, there’s a lot to be excited about as you return to an adventure that has managed to withstand the test of time, and even go toe-to-toe with the genre's latest titles. We’ve put together a list of things we’d like to do first once we get our hands on it, and we’re happy to tell you all about why they’re the ones that have caught our eye. Hope on deck and let’s set sail.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - 15 Things We Can't Wait To Do
